query: Show the client, sidecar, and orchestrator exchanging messages for one voice turn.
inputs: client dials -> sidecar opens tunnel -> orchestrator streams reply -> spoken audio back
expected_behavior: emits a single well-formed svg using the svg-node vocabulary
draws each actor as a column with a vertical lifeline
orders the messages top to bottom with a flowlbl on each

query: Draw the pairing handshake between two sidecars, including the failure reply.
expected_behavior: uses a distinct accent for a failure or abort message (coral)
keeps the messages in their real order

query: The protocol has twenty frames; draw the sequence.
expected_behavior: shows only the handful of messages that make the decision rather than the full trace
